quests.passage: Residents are reminded that bulky items such as mattresses and old sofas will not be collected with normal rubbish. To arrange a special pickup, call the council at least three days in advance. There is a small charge, which is added to the next council tax bill. quests.explanation: "Arrange a special pickup" and "book a special collection" say the same thing. The wrong options reuse words from the passage but describe actions the notice rules out or mentions only as a payment method.
